definition.en: The World Trade Organization (WTO) is the only global international organization dealing with the rules of trade between nations.
definition.hi: The World Trade Organization (WTO) is the only global international organization dealing with the rules of trade between nations.

importanceInUpsc.en: The WTO is a critical component of the GS-3 syllabus under the Indian Economy section, specifically regarding external sector policies and international trade agreements. Understanding its mechanisms is essential for analyzing India's stance in global trade negotiations and its impact on domestic economic policies.
